//: Standalone project registry (p6-registry-core). Replaces config-substrate.mjs's
hardcoded PROJECT_NAMES/PROJECT_IDS/PROJECT_LANE object literals — that module now
derives those three exports from this file at import time (lib/project-registry.mjs).
Edit via `auriga project add/remove` (p6-project-cli) once that lands; hand-editing
this file directly works too (see design-discussion.md's HUMAN_NAMES precedent) but
is not concurrency-safe against a simultaneous CLI write (accepted low-probability
risk, grill finding H4 — single-operator tool, not a multi-writer service).
`dispatch_order`: the real, order-sensitive dispatch-eligibility gate (mirrors
today's PROJECT_IDS exactly). A project id NOT in this list is SILENTLY excluded
from real dispatch/cascade — see core.mjs's selectAssignments/detectCascadeDispatch.
Order determines dispatch priority (aligned lanes first, Consus last so it's
drained sparingly). A project can be registered below (known to Auriga, has a
lane) without being dispatch-eligible — see the Minerva entry.
`projects`: every project Auriga knows about. Each entry is
{id, name, notes, lane, registered_at}. `lane` is an optional array of candidate
agent-lane names (mirrors PROJECT_LANE's existing shape); absent/empty falls back
to DEFAULT_LANE, unchanged from today's behavior.
Seeded 2026-08-19 by p6-registry-core: migrated verbatim from
config-substrate.mjs's hardcoded PROJECT_NAMES/PROJECT_IDS/PROJECT_LANE (the 4 real
PROJECT_IDS entries plus Minerva, which is PROJECT_LANE-load-bearing but
dispatch-ineligible today — see that story's migration notes). The other ~12 names
formerly in PROJECT_NAMES are deliberately NOT migrated here — left for a future
`auriga project scan` to re-surface as real candidates, not silently dropped or
silently auto-added.
PRUNED 2026-08-29: the 4 aligned-repo entries (Auriga/Heimdall/Consus/the original
Pantheon Core) from the 2026-08-19 migration were all scoped to a DIFFERENT, stale
Multica workspace that this host no longer talks to (confirmed live via GET
/api/projects against the real, current workspace f32af269-7b85-48d0-8a1b-5b09125b12b4:
it returns exactly ONE project, 032ea2e7 below -- none of the 4 pruned ids exist in
it). They were harmless (a project id that never matches a real issue's project_id
simply never routes anything -- selectAssignments/detectCascadeDispatch silently
no-op), but actively misleading: they implied per-repo 'aligned lane' project
routing was live for this workspace when it structurally could not be. Minerva
stays -- see its own entry's note for why that one is a different, intentional case.
PANT-59 (2026-08-31): added 6 per-god projects created live in workspace f32af269.
The per-god projects replace Pantheon Core as the primary project-per-repo dispatch
surface. Seeds dropped in Consus (god) route to minerva-dev via isSeed() in core.mjs
(overrides PROJECT_LANE); non-seed build stories route to the aligned build lane.

BATCH ONBOARDING 2026-09-15: added 39 personal/Dostal-Tech/client repo projects (Multica project-create batch), all routed to auriga-build fallback lane. Root-caused a real bug: these existed as real Multica projects + had real idea-labeled seed tickets auto-assigned to minerva-dev, but were invisible to Auriga's dispatch entirely because this registry file -- the real dispatch_order gate -- was never updated. That's why the backlog looked frozen after the import (assignedQueued counts static with zero inflight) despite the daemon actively polling and having working credentials.

projects.name: Pantheon Core
projects.notes: Dogfood seed-drop project, REAL workspace (f32af269-7b85-48d0-8a1b-5b09125b12b4) -- created 2026-08-28 because an older 'Pantheon Core' entry (d8ecfab4-..., pruned 2026-08-29, see the top-level comment block) was scoped to a DIFFERENT, stale Multica workspace and did not exist in this one (confirmed live: `project not found in this workspace` when decision-bridge.ts tried to file a ticket there). Consus decision/idea seeds land here (via core-api's DECISION_SEED_PROJECT_ID override) and route to the minerva-dev planning lane via core.mjs's isSeed() check (overrides this entry's own PROJECT_LANE default below); Minerva's decomposed non-seed child stories route to auriga-build. This is the ONLY real project in the live workspace (confirmed via GET /api/projects, 2026-08-29).

projects.name: Heimdall (god)
projects.notes: Per-god project for Heimdall in workspace f32af269 (PANT-59, pantheon-repo-tenant-grouping). GH #80 (2026-09-06): 'heimdall-dev' (the intended aligned, non-codex lane) was confirmed live to not exist as a real Multica agent in this workspace at all -- GET /api/backlog/agents/heimdall-dev 404s, and a full agent-name scan for 'heimdall' finds only heimdall-dev-codex. Worse than a cosmetic gap: chooseAgentForProject's tie-break always preferred the first lane entry with the lowest inflight load, and a nonexistent agent's inflight count is always 0 (nothing ever successfully assigns to it) -- so heimdall-dev always won the tie-break and every Heimdall dispatch attempt likely failed with assign_error before ever reaching heimdall-dev-codex. Pruned to the one real agent. If an aligned opencode Heimdall lane is created in Multica later, re-add it here once its real id is confirmed live -- never guessed.

projects.name: Minerva
